verdict.rationale: Docs describe a clear merchant path — create an Organization/seller agent, click 'Create Service' with pricing/identity requirements, and 'Submit for approval' — plus a dedicated 'Sell to your customers' agents' guide, so merchants can self-initiate onboarding. However, service listing is explicitly approval-gated by Skyfire rather than a pure self-serve flip-a-switch, and there's no documented merchant agreement/TOS signing step or an SLA on approval turnaround. Missing for 10: instant self-serve activation without vendor approval, explicit merchant agreement/contract step, independent confirmation of approval timelines.
